### ExtensionSchema

Refers to the extension's installation schema in [SearchPath](/api/ankus.pgfunctionattribute/#member-4b7aa4ecfc8cee28).
PostgreSQL substitutes this token during CREATE EXTENSION; the generated extension is non-relocatable.
